title: Small Group Pearl Harbor WWII History Tour from Honolulu
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Tour requires walking at a steady pace as much as 3 miles throughout the tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
More Than a Tour—A Deeper Understanding of History
This 6–7 hour experience is designed for guests who want more than a quick visit to Pearl Harbor. Through expert storytelling, firsthand naval experience, historic sites, and time for personal reflection, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of:

The events and tensions leading up to December 7, 1941
The attack on Pearl Harbor and its impact on the United States
The U.S.–Japan relationship before and during World War II
The role of Pearl Harbor in shaping the Pacific War
The extraordinary history of the USS Missouri
The formal end of World War II
The personal stories and sacrifices of those who served

With a maximum of 12 guests, this is a personal, educational, and immersive Pearl Harbor experience—designed to leave you with not only a better understanding of what happened, but a greater appreciation for the people who lived through it.
